verdict.rationale: Granola's own transparency docs say it automatically posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts, notifying all participants. That is a real in-meeting disclosure mechanism, one of the options the story lists, not just a policy document. The evidence is a single short doc line, so its depth and reach are unproven. missing for 10: admin-enforced or workspace-mandated disclosure settings, detail on which meeting platforms receive the chat notice, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Granola posts a message in your meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know.
